title: Price List - Spring 2026
key_sentences: The prices below apply to orders placed between 1 April and 30 June 2026.
All prices exclude value added tax.
Orders above 500 euros are delivered free of charge within the mainland.
Stock levels were counted on 28 March 2026 and may change without notice.
notes: One table, 1 header row (th cells) + 6 data rows x 4 columns, no merged cells, no caption. Numbers use a comma as thousands separator and a dot as decimal separator; cell text is exact. One paragraph before the table, one after.
